From CSV to clarity.

Import a UTF-8 CSV using Choose file or drag and drop. Select a dataset to inspect records and switch to Schema to view columns and missing values.

Files can contain up to 20,000 rows, 100 unique columns, and 5 MiB of data. Empty fields become NULL. Values retain their original text, including leading zeros.

For an illustrative starting point, upload fixtures/retail-example.csv from the repository. It is a labeled example fixture, never loaded automatically.
